blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Check if you have high cholesterol
s: High cholesterol does not usually cause symptoms.
You can only find out if you have it from a blood test.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Check if you have high cholesterol
s: Your GP might suggest having a test to check if your cholesterol level is high.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Check if you have high cholesterol
s: This may be because of your age, weight or a condition you have (like high blood pressure or diabetes).

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Non-urgent advice: Ask your GP surgery for a cholesterol test if:
s: you have not had a test before and you're over 40, overweight, or high cholesterol or heart problems run in your family

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Non-urgent advice: Ask your GP surgery for a cholesterol test if:
s: You're more likely to have high cholesterol.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Non-urgent advice: Ask your GP surgery for a cholesterol test if:
s: You can also get a cholesterol test at a pharmacy, but you might have to pay for it.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Having a cholesterol test
s: There are 2 ways of having a cholesterol test.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Having a cholesterol test > Taking blood from your arm
s: Some blood will usually be taken from your arm with a needle.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Having a cholesterol test > Taking blood from your arm
s: This is sent to a lab to check your cholesterol level.
You should get the result in a few days.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Having a cholesterol test > Taking blood from your arm
s: You might be asked not to eat anything (to fast) for up to 12 hours before the test.
But most people do not need to fast.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Having a cholesterol test > Finger-prick test
s: If you're over 40, you may have a test during your NHS Health Check.
You can also get this check at a pharmacy.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Having a cholesterol test > Finger-prick test
s: This is a check-up that can help spot early signs of problems like heart disease and diabetes.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Having a cholesterol test > Finger-prick test
s: The test can be done by pricking your finger.
A drop of blood is put on a strip of paper.
This is put into a machine that checks your cholesterol in a few minutes.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Having a cholesterol test > View your results online
s: Results of tests you had at your GP surgery, and results that have been shared with your GP surgery, may be available in your online GP health record.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > Having a cholesterol test > View your results online
s: View test results in your GP health record

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > What happens next
s: If you have high cholesterol, a doctor or nurse will talk to you about how you can lower it.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > What happens next
s: This might include things like changing your diet or taking medicine.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > What happens next
s: They may also work out your risk of having a heart attack or stroke in the next 10 years.

blocks.path: Getting tested - High cholesterol > What happens next
s: Lowering your cholesterol can help lower your risk of having a heart attack or stroke.
